title: feat(motion): Bore gets a Helical strategy (one helix to the floor, then a floor circle)
body:
## What changed

- New `BoreStrategy` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore_helix.rs`): `Rings` (the level ladder, the default and every earlier bore) or `Helical { spring_pass }`. `BoreParams` and `OpParams::Bore` get the field `strategy`.
- A helical hole has these moves:
  1. A rapid over the helix start at the clearance height.
  2. A rapid down to the plunge height over the material.
  3. One continuous helix on the wall radius (`rc = R - r - leave`, the same circle as the last ring) to the floor.
  4. One flat floor circle. With `spring_pass`, a second floor circle.
  5. A feed to the centre at the floor, then a rapid up to clearance.
  
  A through hole's helix ends at the floor less the break-through. The helix is arcs of at most half a turn, so each arc posts as one G2/G3 with Z.
- The pitch is `stepdown`. The Heights tab calls it "Helix pitch" for a helical Bore. Climb is CCW, as for the rings.
- Two refusals in `BoreParams::validate`, before any move is built:
  - A hole that one helix cannot clear to the centre (`rc > floor reach`). For a flat end mill, the limit is twice the tool diameter. The message gives the core and the widest hole.
  - A helix steeper than 15 deg. The message gives the largest pitch that fits.
- Detect holes (`crates/app/src/operation/bore_reach.rs`) skips, and names, the holes that one helix cannot clear when the Bore is helical.
- Project file: `helical` and `spring_pass` on the `bore` record, written only when true. A ring ladder writes the same JSON as before. No version step (see the decision file).
- Stamp: the digest writes the strategy only for a helical Bore. A ring ladder keeps the stamp that it had.
- MCP: `list_operation_types` lists `helical` and `spring_pass` for `bore`. A params patch sets them.
- UI (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs`): a Strategy combo and a Spring pass check on the Passes tab, the "Helix pitch" label on the Heights tab, and a Lead-in hint that the level links do not apply.
- Guide: a "Helical strategy" part in the Bore section of `site/content/guide/operations/operations-2d.md`, and two rows in `site/content/guide/reference/refusals.md`.
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/2830-helical-bore.md`.
- Mechanical: each `BoreParams` and `OpParams::Bore` literal in the tests gets `strategy: Default::default()` (the ring ladder).

## Readings

The issue's counterbore, posted with `assets/posts/linuxcnc.cps`. The model is a revolved block with a Ø11 x 7 recess at the origin (top Z0). The tool is EM-0600-4FL (Ø6 flat), with a 1 mm pitch, climb, clearance 10 and retract 5. A scratch test built the document with the commands, then called `posting::post_script`. It is not committed. The status is Ok and the post has no warning. The cutting part of the program:

```
G0 Z10
G0 X2.5 Y0
G0 X2.5 Y0 Z10
G0 X2.5 Y0 Z2
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z1.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z1 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z0.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z0 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z-0.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z-1 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z-1.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z-2 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z-2.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z-3 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z-3.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z-4 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z-4.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z-5 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z-5.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z-6 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z-6.5 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z-7 I2.5 J0 F600
G3 X-2.5 Y0 Z-7 I-2.5 J0 F600
G3 X2.5 Y0 Z-7 I2.5 J0 F600
G1 X0 Y0 Z-7 F600
G0 X0 Y0 Z10
```

- The helix starts at the plunge height (Z2) and drops 0.5 mm in each half turn to Z-7. There is no straight plunge.
- The two flat arcs at Z-7 are the floor circle. The G1 goes off the wall to the centre before the retract.
- The same document with the Rings strategy also posts with no warning (95 lines; a G1 plunge at the centre for each of the 7 levels).
- The first `G0 X2.5 Y0` line comes before the `G0 X2.5 Y0 Z10` line: the post writes its approach first. The Rings program has the same pattern.

## Pinning tests

- `bore_helix` (motion, new):
  - `the_counterbore_is_one_helix_on_the_wall_then_a_floor_circle_and_never_a_plunge`: the issue's Ø11 x 7 counterbore with a Ø6 flat end mill at 1 mm per turn. No axial feed, no `Plunge` move, the arcs on `rc`, nine turns from 2 mm over the top to the floor, one floor circle, a feed to the centre, a retract.
  - `the_spring_pass_is_a_second_floor_circle`, `conventional_milling_turns_the_helix_clockwise`, `a_through_hole_helix_runs_on_by_the_break_through`.
  - `a_hole_one_helix_cannot_clear_is_refused_with_the_widest_it_can` (Ø12 passes, Ø14 is refused with "2.000 mm core" and "12.000 mm").
  - `a_helix_steeper_than_the_limit_is_refused_with_the_pitch_that_fits` (Ø6.5: 32.5 deg; the given pitch then passes).
  - `the_rings_strategy_is_the_default_and_keeps_its_centre_dive`.
- `bore_helical` (app, new):
  - `the_issue_counterbore_is_one_helix_and_never_plunges_into_the_block`: through `operation::generate`, with a centre-cutting and a non-centre-cutting tool. `first_solid_plunge` finds no plunge, the verifier gives no warning, 18 half-turn arcs, the floor reached. The ring ladder still dives.
  - `a_hole_too_wide_for_one_helix_is_refused_through_the_operation`.
  - `the_strategy_rides_the_project_file_and_an_older_file_reads_rings`.
  - `the_stamp_moves_when_the_strategy_changes`.
- `operation::bore_reach::tests::detect_for_a_helical_bore_skips_the_holes_one_helix_cannot_clear` (app lib).
- `egui_app::tests::bore_strategy` (ui lib, new): the Strategy row defaults to Rings, Helical shows the Spring pass check, and the Heights tab names the pitch.

## Gates

- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 687 steps.
  - The first full run had 685 ok and 2 red steps: `app build (--no-run)` and `app suites: break_through`. The cause was one test literal: the `strategy` field was in a Drill literal in `crates/app/tests/break_through.rs`, not in the Bore literal.
  - After the fix, `--failed` on that run: 2 steps, 0 failed. The fix changed only that test file.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes (`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`) on the final head c70e84309: the motion and app heavy lanes, 231 steps, 0 failed (50.3 min).

## Not exercised

- No air cut on a machine. The reporter offered in the issue to test the counterbore case.
- No GUI check by hand. The UI tests assert the rows and the combo value.
- The Bore seed stepdown is the carried stepdown (often 5 mm). A Ø11 hole with a Ø6 tool at 5 mm per turn is 17.7 deg and is refused, with the pitch to type (4.2 mm). The page does not change the stepdown when the strategy changes.
- The helix does not read the Lead-in radial engagement limit or the lead feed percentage. It reads the plunge height, the stock top and the ramp feed.
- A hole wider than twice the tool diameter is refused for the helix. The issue permits a refusal. An inner helix followed by rings is not in this PR.
- A non-centre-cutting tool helixes like any other tool. The 15 deg limit keeps the descent shallow. No tool record has a ramp limit to read.

Changelog: The Bore operation has a Helical strategy: one continuous helix on the wall radius to the floor, one floor circle, an optional spring pass, then a move to the centre. It cuts a counterbore or a hole up to twice the tool diameter without a plunge.

Branch made from `upstream/main` at 2b95e5701.

Fixes #2830
